_source: Amazon Ads Reporting API v1 field pages, line 'Version 3 Reporting Name (DSP)', read 2026-11-01. Reporting API v3 shuts off after 2027-06-30; v1 is the replacement (POST /adsApi/v1/create/reports).

clickThroughs.note: v1 overview: "Click-throughs" -> "Clicks"; its page prints v3 name "clicks"

purchases14d.note: v1 page prints the v3 name as "purchases", without the 14d suffix

purchasesClicks14d.note: v1 page prints the v3 name as "purchasesClicks", without the 14d suffix

sales14d.note: v1 page prints the v3 name as "sales", without the 14d suffix

ROAS14d.note: not seen under this v3 name (metric.roasPromoted prints v3 name "roas")

dpv14d.note: not seen under this v3 name (metric.detailPageViewsPromoted prints v3 name "detailPageViews")
